say:1:1641113001:1.text: The Lyceum attracts students of all stripes and colors—Lightbearers, Wilders, Maulers... you name it.
say:1:1641113001:1.source_cn: 莱希拉姆的学生来自各个地方，耀光、绿裔、蛮血……谁都能进来！
say:1:1641113001:1.male: The Lyceum attracts students of all stripes and colors—Lightbearers, Wilders, Maulers... you name it.
say:1:1641113001:1.female: The Lyceum attracts students of all stripes and colors—Lightbearers, Wilders, Maulers... you name it.

say:2:1641113002:1.text: But most Wilder kids prefer the Astral Academy. As for the Maulers, they aren't exactly fond of leaving their deserts, so yeah, they're a rarer sight here.
say:2:1641113002:1.source_cn: 不过绿裔多半去星界学院，蛮血也由于某种原因不太愿意离开...
say:2:1641113002:1.male: But most Wilder kids prefer the Astral Academy. As for the Maulers, they aren't exactly fond of leaving their deserts, so yeah, they're a rarer sight here.
say:2:1641113002:1.female: But most Wilder kids prefer the Astral Academy. As for the Maulers, they aren't exactly fond of leaving their deserts, so yeah, they're a rarer sight here.

say:3:1641113003:1.text: Running into one of them is like spotting a lone cactus in a wide-open meadow—rare, unexpected, and hard to forget.
say:3:1641113003:1.source_cn: 就像广阔草原上偶尔会冒出来一株孤零零的仙人掌，虽然少，...
say:3:1641113003:1.male: Running into one of them is like spotting a lone cactus in a wide-open meadow—rare, unexpected, and hard to forget.
say:3:1641113003:1.female: Running into one of them is like spotting a lone cactus in a wide-open meadow—rare, unexpected, and hard to forget.

say:4:1641113004:1.text: Their way of thinking opens up entirely new magical approaches. Maybe that's why Professor Solise and I were chosen to oversee the Skyrealm Forest.
say:4:1641113004:1.source_cn: 他们的视角往往能带来新的魔法思路，或许这也是我能和娑丽...
say:4:1641113004:1.male: Their way of thinking opens up entirely new magical approaches. Maybe that's why Professor Solise and I were chosen to oversee the Skyrealm Forest.
say:4:1641113004:1.female: Their way of thinking opens up entirely new magical approaches. Maybe that's why Professor Solise and I were chosen to oversee the Skyrealm Forest.

say:5:1641113005:1.text: To this day, both Wilder and Mauler cultures remain closely connected to nature, in belief as well as tradition.
say:5:1641113005:1.source_cn: 绿裔、蛮血，这两大族裔的文化与思想至今仍然与自然密切相关。
say:5:1641113005:1.male: To this day, both Wilder and Mauler cultures remain closely connected to nature, in belief as well as tradition.
say:5:1641113005:1.female: To this day, both Wilder and Mauler cultures remain closely connected to nature, in belief as well as tradition.

say:7:1641113006:1.text: I do. When the desert wind swept through campus, it felt like sitting beside a fire, even when there was no flame.
say:7:1641113006:1.source_cn: 当然。沙漠的热风吹过来，像篝火一样让人安心。
say:7:1641113006:1.male: I do. When the desert wind swept through campus, it felt like sitting beside a fire, even when there was no flame.
say:7:1641113006:1.female: I do. When the desert wind swept through campus, it felt like sitting beside a fire, even when there was no flame.

say:8:1641113008:1.text: At first, I couldn't handle the damp here. These stone dorms felt like sleeping inside a cold well.
say:8:1641113008:1.source_cn: 一开始我不习惯这里的湿冷，待在石头屋里像掉进冰窟窿。
say:8:1641113008:1.male: At first, I couldn't handle the damp here. These stone dorms felt like sleeping inside a cold well.
say:8:1641113008:1.female: At first, I couldn't handle the damp here. These stone dorms felt like sleeping inside a cold well.

say:9:1641113009:1.text: So I planted sunflowers wherever I could. It helped a lot.
say:9:1641113009:1.source_cn: 后来我尽可能在附近种了一些太阳花，情况就好多了。
say:9:1641113009:1.male: So I planted sunflowers wherever I could. It helped a lot.
say:9:1641113009:1.female: So I planted sunflowers wherever I could. It helped a lot.

say:11:1641113010:1.text: Absolutely not. That's the one thing I'm still struggling with.
say:11:1641113010:1.male: Absolutely not. That's the one thing I'm still struggling with.
say:11:1641113010:1.female: Absolutely not. That's the one thing I'm still struggling with.

say:12:1641113012:1.text: Of course, tastes differ—that's to be expected. So Professor Solise and I started cultivating a few crops that feel more familiar to those of us from outside the Lightbearer Empire.
say:12:1641113012:1.source_cn: 不过众口难调是难免的，为了能让耀光外的族裔们能够适应，...
say:12:1641113012:1.male: Of course, tastes differ—that's to be expected. So Professor Solise and I started cultivating a few crops that feel more familiar to those of us from outside the Lightbearer Empire.

say:13:1641113013:1.text: Food's just one part of it. There are still a few everyday challenges, of course, but we're all working through them together.
say:13:1641113013:1.source_cn: 当然还有一些其他生活问题，通过大家的努力，都在慢慢解决了。
say:13:1641113013:1.male: Food's just one part of it. There are still a few everyday challenges, of course, but we're all working through them together.

choice:10:0:1.text: And the food? Getting used to that?
choice:10:0:1.source_cn: 这里的食物合你口味吗？
choice:10:0:1.male: And the food? Getting used to that?
choice:10:0:1.female: And the food? Getting used to that?

say:15:1641113011:1.text: All of it. If it's something my people made, it's something I'd call a feast.
say:15:1641113011:1.source_cn: 所有。只要是蛮血喜欢的，对我来说都是美味佳肴。
say:15:1641113011:1.male: All of it. If it's something my people made, it's something I'd call a feast.
say:15:1641113011:1.female: All of it. If it's something my people made, it's something I'd call a feast.

choice:10:1:2.text: What Mauler food do you miss the most?
choice:10:1:2.source_cn: 你最想念哪种家乡食物？
choice:10:1:2.male: What Mauler food do you miss the most?
choice:10:1:2.female: What Mauler food do you miss the most?

say:16:1641113007:1.text: It's been a long time. My people have always moved with the seasons. Home was never one place—it was wherever the tents were.
say:16:1641113007:1.source_cn: 很久。我的族人一直迁徙，故乡本来就不是固定的地方。
say:16:1641113007:1.male: It's been a long time. My people have always moved with the seasons. Home was never one place—it was wherever the tents were.
say:16:1641113007:1.female: It's been a long time. My people have always moved with the seasons. Home was never one place—it was wherever the tents were.

choice:6:1:2.text: When's the last time you went back?
choice:6:1:2.male: When's the last time you went back?
choice:6:1:2.female: When's the last time you went back?
